spoken_summary: Zohran Mamdani gives a speech at what appears to be his mayoral inauguration. He addresses both those who voted for him and those who did not, acknowledging that some view his administration with distrust. He promises to be a mayor for all residents of the city, stating, "If you are a New Yorker, I am your mayor." He vows to protect, celebrate with, and mourn alongside everyone, and never to hide from them.

central_claim: Zohran Mamdani, as the new mayor of New York City, will represent and serve all New Yorkers, including those who did not support him.
intended_effect: To inspire confidence in Zohran Mamdani's leadership and present him as a unifying figure for New York City.
